title: Cellular Fragility and Neural Sickness of OSRNs within the Olfactory Neuroepithelium of Fish
content: Olfactory neuroepithelium is a pseudostratified structure in fish [5]. The morphs of neural cells within the olfactory neuroepithelium show distinct structural variations of their position and function respectively [4]. These neural cells performed their regular activities in their respective condition [3]. Effects of habitat destruction are major events that directly unstable the units of living system i.e., cells as well as the physiology of the species concerned. The cellular fragility is directly influencing the neural dysfunction in higher vertebrates. The definite modalities of the neural cell's function are not well examined within the olfactory neuroepithelium of fish. It is very much essential to examine that How does the frequent distortion of subcellular components of olfactory sensory receptor neurons (OSRNs) changes their functional modality within the olfactory neuroepithelium of fish in a particular habitat?
